name: B10-0546/2025 (PPE) – EU position on the proposed plan and EU engagement towards a just and lasting peace for Ukraine
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the EU position on the proposed plan and EU engagement towards a just and lasting peace for Ukraine
part_text:
The European Parliament states its position on two competing peace plans for Ukraine. It rejects the 28-point plan drafted by US and Russian representatives, saying it would force Ukraine to give up and accept Russian land grabs. It backs the European counterproposal as the basis for talks. It says any peace must respect Ukraine's borders, involve Ukraine and the EU, and include security guarantees, compensation from Russia, and accountability for war crimes. The text is an opinion; it does not change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only states its view on the two peace plans.
- **Who it affects:** Ukraine, Russia, the United States, EU governments and NATO.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to the Council, Commission, member states, Ukraine and the United Nations.
